contact-example.name: Example contact form
contact-example.description: A noncollecting example of the Forms plugin. Configure it for your own operation before use.
contact-example.purpose: Demonstrate minimal contact fields without accepting or retaining messages.
contact-example.noticeText: Demonstration only: no messages are accepted. A live form needs the operator’s purpose, privacy information and delivery channel.
contact-example.successText: Message accepted by the delivery service.

privacy-request-example.name: Privacy request example
privacy-request-example.description: A noncollecting model for human-reviewed privacy requests. No identity documents are requested.
privacy-request-example.purpose: Route a privacy request to the operator for proportional identity assessment and a documented response.
privacy-request-example.noticeText: Demonstration only. The operator must define the applicable basis, notice, response process and retention before enabling collection.
privacy-request-example.successText: Message accepted by the delivery service.
